title: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.07461v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How can an agent handle a real-world task end to end? Frontier models with their own harnesses still fall short on real-world benchmarks: on Terminal-Bench 4.0, GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex resolves 37.3% of the tasks and Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code 51.8%. These tasks fail at the step from reaching a resource to applying it, which we call the last mile to the real world. Existing approaches put the resource within reach but leave the competence to apply it with the caller, so each harness rebuilds that competence. We introduce agent-native primitives, reusable units that equip a resource with a resident LLM that applies it in context and communicates with other primitives, and HEELO (Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks), a harness engineering framework that builds each task's harness from a library of such primitives. translated_title: 通往真实世界的最后一英里：作为解决真实世界任务的可复用构建块的智能体原生原语
translated_abstract: 智能体如何端到端地处理真实世界任务？配备各自框架的前沿模型在真实世界基准测试中仍然表现不佳：在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上，GPT-5.6 Sol 配合 Codex 仅解决 37.3% 的任务，Claude Opus 5 配合 Claude Code 解决 51.8%。这些任务在从获取资源到应用资源的步骤上失败，我们将其称为通往真实世界的最后一英里。现有方法只是将资源置于可及范围内，却把应用资源的能力留给调用者，因此每个框架都需要重建这种能力。我们提出了智能体原生原语——一种可复用的单元，它为资源配备一个常驻 LLM，该 LLM 能在上下文中应用该资源并与其他原语通信；同时提出 HEELO（围绕不断演化的智能体原生原语构建的框架工程方法，用于真实世界任务的最后一英里），这是一个从此类原语库为每个任务构建框架的框架工程方法。HEELO 将任务所需的原语组合成任务特定的框架……
tldr: 提出智能体原生原语与 HEELO 框架，通过为资源配备常驻 LLM 并从原语库组合出任务专用框架，弥合从获取资源到实际应用资源之间“通往真实世界的最后一英里”。
en_tdlr: Proposes agent-native primitives and the HEELO framework, which equip resources with resident LLMs and compose them into task-specific harnesses to bridge the "last mile" from accessing a resource to actually applying it in real-world tasks.
